Article 4 (Procedures for Conferral of Emeritus Status)
(1) Where the president or dean (excluding a dean of a college within a university; hereinafter referred to as the "head of the university") intends to confer the title of emeritus professor, the head shall obtain the consent of the relevant university personnel committee (or the faculty personnel committee in the case of a private university).
(2) Matters concerning procedures for conferring the title of emeritus professor, other than those prescribed by these Rules, shall be prescribed by the school regulations of the relevant university.
